        "null"

        "string",
        "null"
      ],

    },
    "is_confidential_omitted": {
      "type": [
        "boolean",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false."

          },

          "shares_or_principal_type": {
            "type": "string",

              "PRN"

            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"

            "enum": [

Note: the filer-agent CIK in the EDGAR submission is often the filing agent, not the manager itself."}, "report_calendar_quarter_end": {"type": "string", "description": "Period of report. Filed in MM-DD-YYYY format on the cover page; normalize to ISO YYYY-MM-DD before comparison."}, "is_amendment": {"type": ["boolean", "null"], "description": "True for 13F-HR/A. When true, supersedes the original for the same (manager, period). Output null when the cover page does not state amendment status."}, "amendment_type": {"type": ["string", "null"], "description": "When is_amendment=true, one of 'RESTATEMENT' or 'NEW HOLDINGS'."}, "report_type": {"type": "string", "enum": ["13F HOLDINGS REPORT", "13F NOTICE", "13F COMBINATION REPORT"], "description": "Filing role. Combination reports include positions held on behalf of other managers; Notice means the manager is filing nothing this quarter (covered elsewhere)."}, "is_confidential_omitted": {"type": ["boolean", "null"], "description": "True when the manager has filed a 13F-CTR for confidential treatment of specific positions; the InfoTable then omits those rows. Output null when the cover page does not state this. Do NOT default to false."}, "table_entry_total": {"type": "integer", "description": "Cover-page count of holdings rows. Should equal len(holdings) — useful as a self-consistency check."}, "table_value_total_usd": {"type": "integer", "description": "Cover-page total market value across all positions. Since 2023-Q1 reported in whole dollars (was thousands earlier).               "null"
            ],

          "investment_discretion": {
            "type": "string",
            "enum": [

          "voting_authority_none": {
            "type": "integer",

          }
        },
        "required": [

        ]
      }

  "type": "object",
  "title": "Synthetic election statement-of-votes pivot schema",
  "description": "Extract the county header, the per-contest column definitions, and every precinct row from a precinct-by-precinct Statement of Votes Cast. Each contest is a pivot grid: rows are precincts, columns are the contest's candidates plus Write-In / Over Votes / Under Votes. The same precincts repeat in every contest. Do NOT extract the bold 'Total' row -- it is a column summary, not a precinct.",
  "required": [
    "jurisdiction",
    "election_title",
    "election_date",
    "contests",
    "precinct_results"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "jurisdiction": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "County named in the page header, e.g. 'Goshen County'."
    },
    "election_title": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Report title from the header, e.g. 'Official Precinct-by-Precinct Summary'."
    },
    "election_date": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Election date printed in the header, e.g. 'November 5, 2024'."
    },
    "contests": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "One entry per contest (one per page), defining its columns in order.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "office",
          "columns"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "office": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Contest title printed above the grid, e.g. 'United States Senator'."
          },
          "columns": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "Data column headers left-to-right (candidates then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes); aligns positionally with each row's votes.",
            "items": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "precinct_results": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Every precinct row of every contest, in document order. Excludes the 'Total' summary row printed at the foot of each contest.",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "required": [
          "office",
          "precinct",
          "votes",
          "source_page"
        ],
        "properties": {
          "office": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Contest this row belongs to (the page's title heading)."
          },
          "precinct": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "Precinct label (row header), e.g. '07-2' or 'Absentee'."
          },
          "votes": {
            "type": "array",
            "description": "Vote counts in printed column order, aligned to this contest's 'columns' (candidates, then Write-In, Over Votes, Under Votes).",
            "items": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "source_page": {
            "type": "integer",
            "description": "One-indexed PDF page where the row is printed."
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
